conditions.evidence: adult patients with unilateral vestibular schwannoma
conditions.label: vestibular schwannoma

modalities.evidence: contrast-enhanced T1-weighted (T1CE) scans and 133 T2 scans
demographic data (sex, ethnicity, age) and clinical decisions recorded at each time point

output.population: 190 adult patients with unilateral vestibular schwannoma (VS), referred to King's College Hospital, London, UK; patients with neurofibromatosis type 2 (NF2) were excluded
output.summary: Multi-center routine clinical MRI of adults with unilateral vestibular schwannoma, with longitudinal scans, consensus deep-learning-derived tumor segmentations, demographics and clinical decisions, supporting surveillance, segmentation and growth modeling research.
